articles.summary: STING RETURNS TO THE COLOSSEUM AT CAESARS PALACE WITH NEW LAS VEGAS RESIDENCY STING 3.0 TICKETS GO ON SALE SATURDAY, OCT. 17 AT 10 A.M. PT SHOWS BEGIN MARCH 4, 2027 Click HERE for photo and admat Photo credit: Carter B. Smith LAS VEGAS (Oct. 13, 2026) The Cherrytree Music Company, Live Nation and Caesars Entertainment announce that 17-time GRAMMY Award-winning musician Sting will return to The Colosseum at Caesars Palace with a new Las Vegas residency, STING 3.0. Launching Thursday, March 4, 2027 , the engagement follows his universally celebrated STING 3.0 World Tour and marks his return to The Colosseum after his critically acclaimed My Songs residency, which featured 22 sold-out performances from 2021 through 2023. Accompanied by longtime guitarist Dominic Miller and dynamic drummer Chris Maas (Mumford Sons, Maggie Rogers) , STING 3.0 reinvents Stings
articles.title: Sting Returns to The Colosseum at Caesars Palace with New Las Vegas Residency "Sting 3.0"

articles.summary: Caesars Entertainment, Inc. ( NASDAQ: CZR ) (“Caesars”, “the Company”) will release its financial results for the third quarter after the market closes on Tuesday, October 27, 2026. Considering the Company’s pending merger with Fertitta Entertainment announced on May 28, 2026, Caesars will not host an earnings call. Upon completion of the proposed merger agreement, Caesars’ common stock will no longer be listed on NASDAQ, and the Company will become a private entity. About Caesars Entertainment, Inc. Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) is the largest casino-entertainment company in the US and one of the world’s most diversified casino-entertainment providers. Since its beginning in Reno, NV, in 1937, Caesars Entertainment, Inc. has grown through development of new resorts, expansions and acquisitions. articles.summary: JOHN FOGERTY ANNOUNCES RETURN TO PH LIVE AT PLANET HOLLYWOOD RESORT CASINO Performances of John Fogerty: Live in Las Vegas to Take Place February 11, 12 13, 2027 Tickets Go On Sale Friday, Oct. 9 at 10 a.m. PT Click HERE for admat and photos LAS VEGAS, NV (Oct. 6, 2026) GRAMMY winner, Rock Roll Hall of Famer, and Songwriters Hall of Famer, John Fogerty, is set to return to PH Live at Planet Hollywood Resort Casino in 2027. Performances of John Fogerty, Live in Las Vegas are scheduled for Thursday, Feb. 11; Friday, Feb. 12 ; and Saturday, Feb. 13, 2027. Citi is the official card of John Fogerty, Live in Las Vegas at PH Live at Planet Hollywood Resort Casino. Citi cardmembers will have access to presale tickets beginning Wednesday, Oct. 7 at 10 a.m. PT until Thursday, Oct. 8 at 10 p.m. PT through the Citi Entertainment program.
